add.title: LivePage: card titles one step smaller than the page h1
add.why: On /live/demos/code-card/ at 1200, .live-card-title draws almost as large as the h1, so three cards read as three sections (code-card review, finding 4).

add.title: Commit the pages voice makes under /live/ (or end the temporary public/live/ ignore)
add.why: The .gitignore line from 2026-10-19 keeps new public/live/ files untracked, while the committed /live/page.jsonl links them (div-test, item-test). Every worktree smoke then fails on the missing page; fixed once by hand in a9aef7556, and it will recur with the next page voice makes.

add.title: /live/design/ fails smoke: text touching its box
add.why: Server/smoke.mjs reports '.page.live-page.active-page 0px from left' on /live/design/ and /live/design/settings/, on compliance/dev as well as worktree/live-r16 (2026-11-06), so every /live/ merge smoke shows one FAIL that is not its own.

complete.outcome: Fixed: one LivePage.css rule gives a subclass's extra row (DesignPage's page.ui strip) the column's padding; the r14 layout had taken it away.
